body: katana_apply_damage (the real hit-application function for all weapons despite its name) called phys_respawn() synchronously the instant health hit 0 -- state reset to ALIVE and health to 100 before the function even returned, so STATE_DEAD never persisted for even one server tick. Snapshots broadcast every 3 ticks (~48ms), structurally slower than an instantaneous death+respawn, so no client could ever observe a death happening -- confirmed via 3 separate E2E combat runs (60s/30s, multiple weapons, multiple bot counts) all showing deaths=0 respawns=0 despite repeatedly confirmed damage. Fixed with a new respawn_delay_ticks countdown field on PlayerState (server-only, not part of the wire protocol): death sets STATE_DEAD + ~2.9s countdown instead of respawning immediately; update_entity, already called every tick for STATE_DEAD players by the main loop's existing else-branch, counts it down and calls phys_respawn() at zero. Removed the old respawn_time-timestamp check in the main loop -- it was dead code for PvP kills (superseded by the synchronous respawn) and, separately, was itself non-functional even when reached, since respawn_time defaults to 0 and nothing else ever set it, making 'now > respawn_time' unconditionally true. Also fixed a related latent bug: death now explicitly clamps health to 0 rather than leaving it however-negative the damage subtraction produced, since a negative int cast to the wire protocol's unsigned char would wrap to a large bogus value the instant death became observable -- harmless before this fix since nobody could ever see the DEAD tick anyway, but would have mattered immediately after it if left alone. Live-verified after restart: 2-bot 30s shotgun-only combat shows deaths=5/respawns=4 and deaths=4/respawns=4 (one bot mid-death-delay at test end, expected), both counts now correctly nonzero and mutually consistent for the first time. Also renamed the tournaments platform to WOTAN per founder direction (Norse theme), updated NORTHSTAR + okemily.com/tournaments.html live. shankpit-460 commits d185fc5 + f54e00f.
title: Death is now observable over the network (S155-03 fixed)
